why_relevant: Repackages NBS/SBA figures into dated, citable ATM and card counts; useful as a quick cross-check and for spotting when official series change, though always to be traced back to NBS/SBA.

source_name: LinkedIn company pages of SK fintech associations and members
why_relevant: FINAS, SFA and SAPIE post member announcements, onboarding of new members and event partners on LinkedIn (member mentions observed include AD Strategies, ANASOFT, Enehano DigFin). Often the fastest public signal that a firm has joined the ecosystem or partnered with a bank.

source_name: Register.peniaze.sk — cross-register aggregator of SK entities and persons
why_relevant: Free consolidated lookup pulling multiple SK registers into one profile (company and person view). Useful as a quick triangulation layer and for person-level searches on vendor directors when ORSR person search is awkward.

source_name: Apify 'Finstat.sk Company Data Scraper' — third-party extraction actor
why_relevant: Evidence that third-party scraping tooling for FinStat exists; relevant mainly as a legal/ethical caution marker for the collection design — the compliant path for FinStat data is the licensed API, not a scraper. Listed so the decision is explicit rather than accidental.

source_name: Backbase corporate site – blog and platform comparison content
why_relevant: Backbase publishes named-client and competitive-positioning content; the site is the entry point to its customer-story section where an SK/CEE engagement-banking deployment would be announced.

source_name: Brink's Czech/CEE cash solutions site (brinks.cz) – regional CIT reference
why_relevant: No distinct SK Brink's site surfaced; the CZ entity documents the CEE CIT lineage (Group 4 Securitas → G4S Cash Services → Brink's) and partnerships that shape the neighbouring/cross-border cash-handling market relevant to SK.
Aggregates vendor-supplied references and reviews in one place; a shortcut for enumerating named Temenos clients and spotting SK/CEE institutions without crawling the vendor site.

why_relevant: Confirms Fiserv operates a Slovak entity (Digital Park II, Einsteinova 25, Bratislava) — likely a delivery/nearshore centre rather than an SK sales presence; important for correctly interpreting Fiserv's SK footprint.

source_name: Gartner Peer Insights / G2 – Backbase vs Temenos vendor comparison profiles
why_relevant: Reviewer profiles occasionally disclose reviewer country/industry, providing weak-signal evidence of platform presence in Slovakia when no case study exists; also useful for competitor positioning.
